title: Medical Receptionist
description:
Medical Receptionist

Location: Macclesfield
Contract: Temporary, initially 3 months (potential to extend up to 6 months)
Hours: Full Time, Monday to Friday, 08:30 - 17:00
Pay Rate: 12.71 - 13.50 per hour (dependent on experience)

Overview

We are currently recruiting for a Medical Receptionist to join a busy healthcare setting in Macclesfield. This is a full-time temporary position initially for 3 months, with the possibility of extension up to 6 months for the right candidate.

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and internal computer systems.
- Professional, approachable, and patient-focused.
- Ability to work efficiently in a busy environment.

title: Project Document Controller
description:
Project Document Controller

Location: Macclesfield

We are looking for an experienced Project Document Controller to join our Asset Information Team, supporting the delivery of engineering and refurbishment projects across a complex client environment. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong document control, asset information, or project support experience who enjoys working closely with project teams and stakeholders to ensure critical asset data is accurate, compliant and ready for operational use.

As Project Document Controller, you will play a key role in managing project information throughout the lifecycle of engineering and facilities projects, ensuring that drawings, manuals, maintenance documentation and asset records are accurately updated and transitioned into operational systems.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing the quality, control and transition of project documentation and asset information.
- Working closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Maintenance Teams and Contractors.
- Creating Asset Information Delivery Plans (AIDPs) at project initiation.
- Tracking and reporting progress against project information deliverables.
- Coordinating Requests for Information (RFIs) from contractors and stakeholders.
- Updating engineering drawings, operating procedures and maintenance documentation following project changes.
- Ensuring documentation is correctly loaded into electronic document management systems.
- Supporting the delivery of asset information across multiple databases and systems.
- Attending project progress meetings and providing input on information management activities.
- Monitoring information handover milestones and escalating any risks to delivery.
- Supporting audits and compliance activities through accurate record management.
- Driving continuous improvement and best practice within information management processes.

What We're Looking For
Essential Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in a Document Controller, Asset Information, Engineering Administration or Project Support role
- Strong working knowledge of Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS)
- Experience managing controlled documentation, revision control and document lifecycles
- Excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills
- Strong database management experience
- Excellent organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail
- Ability to prioritise workloads and meet project deadlines
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders at all levels

Desirable
- Experience supporting engineering, facilities management, construction or capital projects
- Knowledge of BIM, COBie data and asset information management processes
- Understanding of project delivery and change management processes

Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive information management team
- Opportunity to develop your expertise in asset information and document control
- Contribute to the successful delivery of facilities and infrastructure projects within a world-class environment

This vacancy is being advertised by Belcan.

title: Service Desk Customer Liaison
description:
Service Desk Customer Liaison

Macclesfield Full-Time On-Site (5 Days per Week)

Join a Team Where Customer Service Makes a Difference

Are you passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and thrive in a fast-paced environment? We're looking for a Service Desk Customer Liaison to become the vital link between our customers, engineers, and service teams, ensuring every request is handled efficiently and professionally.

This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive and organised individual who enjoys problem-solving, building relationships, and making a real impact on the customer experience.

The Opportunity

As a Service Desk Customer Liaison, you'll be the first point of contact for customers, managing service requests from initial enquiry through to resolution. You'll play a key role in coordinating activities, keeping customers informed, and ensuring a seamless service experience.

Working closely with internal teams, engineers, and external service providers, you'll help drive service excellence while contributing to the smooth day-to-day running of the operation.

Key Responsibilities
- Act as the first point of contact for customer service requests via phone, email, and online systems
- Log, prioritise, and coordinate tasks through internal service management systems
- Monitor incidents and service requests to ensure timely resolution
- Provide regular updates to customers, managing expectations throughout the process
- Escalate urgent issues or service delays where appropriate
- Maintain accurate records and support service reporting activities
- Liaise with engineers and service providers to ensure efficient service delivery
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on customer satisfaction and service performance

About You

We're looking for someone with a positive, customer-first attitude and excellent organisational skills. You'll be comfortable managing multiple priorities, building strong relationships, and working collaboratively as part of a busy team.

You'll Ideally Have:
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- A proactive, flexible, and solutions-focused approach
- Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail
- The ability to prioritise workloads and manage competing demands
- A collaborative and team-oriented mindset
- Confidence using Microsoft Office applications
- Excellent working knowledge of SAP
- A commitment to delivering outstanding customer service

Previous experience within a Service Desk, Customer Service, Coordination, Scheduling, or Support environment would be beneficial, but we welcome applications from individuals with transferable skills and a genuine passion for customer service.

What's in It for You?
- Join a supportive and collaborative team environment
- Gain valuable experience within a busy operational setting
- Opportunities for professional development and career progression
- Be part of a business that values continuous improvement and service excellence
- Work in a role where you can make a direct impact on customer satisfaction

Ready for Your Next Challenge?

If you're a motivated individual who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and delivering outstanding customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your customer service career.
